scope: Publicly released government specimen credentials, permits, ID cards, calibration symbols and reference figures. Includes Iowa state specimens republished by federal E-Verify. Colorado’s 2021 proposal is explicitly labeled. No private issued credentials were curated.
rights: Publisher ownership and sample markings are preserved. Downloaded public material is not assumed to have an open redistribution license. Keep source artwork out of public Git history until its reuse terms have been checked.
